items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And they had people like Hildergard, Maxine Andrews. ... Of course, I worked with a small combination.

ctx.x: A reconstructure of World War II.

Yeah, it was taped at Roseland Stagedoor Ballroom and they had it set up with the, as the Canteen, with the coffee urns and the franks and the donuts and some ex-G.I.'s in uniform and they had this very large orchestra. And they had people like Hildergard, Maxine Andrews. They showed clips from some movie that the Andrew Sisters did. They had a clip there of Louie Jordan doing the G.I. Jive. And of course they had Cab Calloway, the Nicholas Brothers, Connie Haines, and several other people. Of course, I worked…
